ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white central surface area with low-intensity black perimeter masking; approximate 75:25 white-to-black pixel ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white fields in central lobe regions; thick black border along the entire trailing edge and peduncle area. Distinct circular black mottling/spots distributed within the white fields of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with approximately 40-degree angular convergence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, small-amplitude irregular serrations (micro-peaks and valleys) along the black continuous boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the superior edges of both lobes tapering to sharp points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple isolated circular dark pixel clusters on white backgrounds; four distinct spots on the right lobe and three on the left lobe near the median notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions visible on the outer quadrant of the right lobe's white surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring consistent with barnacle removal; visible jagged indentation/minor amputation on the far left distal tip edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Live barnacle clusters (beige high-intensity pixel masses) attached to the far outer tips of both lobes.
